trace.user: Subs are starting to mobilize on Alder Street and I don't trust our insurance files. Start here in Sitegrid: Exhibit D's insurance requirements, and the look-ahead of who mobilizes when.

Exhibit D is clear: $1M per occurrence and $2M aggregate on an occurrence form, plus both CG 20 10 and CG 20 37 naming Kestrel Ridge and Alder Street Partners (location 1180 Alder Street, if one is named). The policy on Coverwell counts, not the certificate. Next I'll read Subhub's vendor list and Coverwell's policy list.

I couldn't read Subhub or Coverwell because this session is pinned to Sitegrid. Their tools only work while I'm switched to those tabs.
